description: Search Dutch national legislation by title (the BWB Basiswettenbestand). Matches the cite-title and official/unofficial titles as a phrase and returns the regulation(s) in force on "as_of" (default today), with BWB ids (BWBR...) that nl_wetten_get_law and nl_wetten_get_article take. Title search only — does not search article full text.

as_of.description: Resolve matches to the version valid on this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

query.description: Title words to match, e.g. "Algemene wet bestuursrecht" or "Wetboek van Strafrecht". Dutch.

name: nl_wetten_search
title: Nl Wetten Search
